evals.name: implement
evals.prompt: Extract coordination from a complicated React editor into an Arc view model. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: Use withViewModel when interaction state has dependencies or lifecycle of its own. For one command input and query tuple keep the binding in the component.
assertions: Extract the decision and its dependency, not the query result array. Done: replacing the dependency changes what the same intent returns.
Bind the model class and read its observable inside the wrapped render. Done: the view sends intent without instantiating a model or copying its fields into useState.

evals.name: diagnose
evals.prompt: Observable caption changes but the wrapped view stays stale. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: If an interaction changes the model but not the view, move the observable read back inside the tracked render. If values leak across views, check whether the model was registered as a singleton. Let the wrapper own model lifetime; release model-owned listeners in detached().
